verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is a SaaS recruiting platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents REST APIs (Harvest, Job Board, Assessment, Candidate Ingestion) and webhooks, but these are developer building blocks rather than an MCP server. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs returned 404, and nothing mentions an official MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
